Products

In the last 30 days the Public AI Inference Utility served 6.6B tokens. chat.publicai.co had 2,169 active users and gained 2,928 sign-ups.

Movement

The Public AI Slack has 678 members. 107 of them posted in the last 30 days and 231 were active, reading or posting. 45 people joined. Partners and events are not counted yet.

Posting and active counts are Slack's own rolling 30-day figures, taken on the last day of each month. Mail and code show the movement too: 25 new threads to hello@publicai.co and 2 GitHub issues in the last 30 days.

Idea

In the last 30 days, 37 new papers used the phrase “public AI” in their title or abstract, against 344 in the past year. Google search interest in the phrase averaged 32, against 47 over the past year.

News counts come from GDELT’s worldwide crawl and papers from OpenAlex. Both count the phrase, so they also catch “public AI tools” and companies named PublicAI: read them as trends. Google search interest is an index where 100 is the peak week since January 2024, not a number of searches. UK Parliament has used the phrase 3 times in Hansard, all in the Lords.

Academic papers using "public AI"CountedWorks in OpenAlex with the phrase in the title or abstract, by publication month, from Jan 2023 (collectors/idea_openalex.py). Google searches for "public AI"CountedWeekly worldwide search interest in the exact phrase, from Jan 2024 (collectors/idea_trends.py). An index where 100 is the peak week, not a number of searches. Window figures are the average index.Google Trends has no public API: the collector uses the endpoints its web page calls. If they break, download the CSV by hand and pass --csv.
